items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: And it was Joel Feene. That little Jimmy, I remember when he just started.

ctx.x: Yeah. About Freddie. Freddie, uh, Jimmy Noon's sister was his lady friend, Freddie. Oh, yeah? And it was Joel Feene. That little Jimmy, I remember when he just started. Him and Sidney, basically.
They were about the same age as you, weren't they? You were about all the same age.
